title: Spur gear on XY: module 2, 24 teeth, 20 degrees, root fillet 0.5, 10 thick, 10 mm bore

expect.note: bbox: outside diameter m(z+2) = 52; 24 teeth put a tooth tip on +-x and +-y; the involute's Bezier approximation (FreeCAD's fcgear) ends 0.001 mm beyond the tip circle, hence abs_tol 0.005. Volume: FreeCAD 1.1.4's Pad of the outline; gear_core.area() (Green's theorem on the same lines, arcs and Beziers) times 10 agrees to 1e-11, but that is the same outline, so the source stays baseline.
